entries.en: proverb; adage
as the old proverb says; the old saying goes
the proverb says; as the saying goes

entries.zh: 削薄；用藤条刮削修整（使薄）
entries.en: to thin by scraping or paring (with a bejuco/vine)

entries.zh: 摺叠；整理、收叠（衣物等）；修补
entries.en: to fold and put in order; to arrange; to mend

entries.zh: 打叠；收拾、整理（行装杂物）
entries.en: to pack up; to arrange, to put things in order
entries.notes: R 栏作三音节（tà tiē tiē），与 H/M 两字不合，或为衍写；释义不依音写。

entries.en: to repair or outfit (a ship)
to repair and put in order; to refit

entries.zh: 重修；重新修缮（房屋、船只）
entries.en: to repair again; to renovate, to rebuild
to boil, to cook (food)
to cook; to prepare (food)
to dress a woman's hair; to put the hair up in a bun

entries.zh: 把东西整治得极好；备办齐整
entries.en: to prepare or adorn something very well
entries.notes: 汉字「双粿」字面难通（粿为米制糕品），释义据西语「adereçar algo muy bien」。

entries.zh: 备办筵席；整治酒食（粿品与酒）
entries.en: to prepare the banquet; to lay out the feast
entries.notes: 「双粿酒」当作粿品与酒食，释义据西语「adereçar el combite」，convite 指筵席。

entries.zh: 练（丝）；煮练生丝使洁白柔软
entries.en: to prepare/dress silk; to boil and whiten raw silk
to tidy up, to arrange (a house)
entries.notes: 汉字「搯」与「整治房屋」义不合，释义据西语栏推定。

entries.en: neat, spruce, well-dressed
neat and tidy; spruce; clean
entries.notes: 「例」为「俐」的同音借写，伶例即伶俐。

entries.zh: 嫩（柔软、幼嫩）〔原件西语栏残缺，所指存疑〕
entries.en: tender; soft; young (Spanish headword lost; referent uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语词头栏空缺，仅据 H/R 栏定「嫩」义，所指不明。

entries.en: ready, handy; prepared in any way
entries.notes: 「便」与「de qualquier suerte」对应较宽，取「齐备、就手」之义。
